rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records is within the 7% threshold.
Verifies that each table meets its expected freshness threshold according to RBI publishing cadence.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Length_Transportation_Road', 'Length_Transportation_StateHighway') THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2020' WHEN StatVar IN ('Consumption_FarmInventory_Fertilizer') THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2022' WHEN StatVar IN ('Area_LandCover_Forest', 'Score_SustainableDevelopmentGoals', 'Area_LandCover_Tree', 'Loss_Electricity_TransmissionAndDistribution_AsAFractionOf_Annual_Generation_Electricity', 'GrossValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland', 'NetValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland', 'Gross_Area_LandCover_IrrigatedLand', 'NetValue_Area_LandCover_IrrigatedLand', 'GrossValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland_AsAFractionOf_NetValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland') THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2023' ELSE MAX(MaxDate) >= '2024' END AS is_fresh, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM stats GROUP BY StatVar
